Gerunds after prepositions · 要点精讲: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
be good at + V-ing|be interested in + V-ing|instead of + V-ing|look forward to + V-ing (to is a preposition)|before/after + V-ing as object
She is good at drawing pictures.

column4: 考查Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。此处应为 drawing。句意:她擅长画画。
